[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a detailed recipe for Rosemary and Olive Oil Focaccia, including ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for Focaccia:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 1/2 cups warm water  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 teaspoons active dry yeast  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 teaspoon salt  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 tablespoons olive oil  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 sprigs of fresh rosemary, chopped  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Coarse sea salt, for topping (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on handling fresh rosemary, including choosing fresh sprigs, storing them, and chopping them just before use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended using about 2-3 sprigs of fresh rosemary, chopped to release about 2-3 tablespoons of leaves for the focaccia recipe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested distributing rosemary evenly in the dough and being mindful of its potency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided additional tips for making focaccia, including not overmixing the dough, letting it rest, and using high-quality olive oil.  
[PREFERENCE] User expressed excitement about trying the Rosemary and Olive Oil Focaccia recipe.
